INSERT INTO automation_logs
  (customer_id, interaction_id, event, classification, retrieved_doc_ids, decision,
   rule_triggered, ai_confidence, human_involved, action_taken, success, error_message)
SELECT (j->>'customer_id')::int, (j->>'interaction_id')::int, j->>'event', j->>'classification',
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(j->'retrieved_doc_ids'))::int[],
       j->>'decision', j->>'rule_triggered', (j->>'ai_confidence')::numeric,
       (j->>'human_involved')::boolean, j->>'action_taken', (j->>'success')::boolean, j->>'error_message'
FROM (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j) p
RETURNING log_id;
